children: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd. on Saturday, November 21, said its wholly owned subsidiary Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd has received a Letter of Award (LoA) to supply 1,750 MW of renewable round-the-clock (RE-RTC) power for 25 years.
The order is from West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Co Ltd (WBSEDCL) for a period of 25 years.
The LoA also includes a 750 MW greenshoe option, which can be exercised by WBSEDCL at a later date. If exercised, the aggregate contracted capacity will rise to 2,500 MW.
Power supply for the initial 1,750 MW capacity is scheduled to begin on July 1, 2028. If the 750 MW greenshoe option is exercised, supply for that capacity is scheduled to begin from April 1, 2029.

“This significant order win strengthens our commitment to deliver scalable energy solutions, and allows us to partner with WBSEDCL in supporting West Bengal’s long-term sustainable power needs,” AESL CEO Kandarp Patel said.
It won the award after a competitive bidding process, with PTSL emerging as the successful bidder after an e-reverse auction.
AESL said PTSL has tied up about 4.6 GW of solar and wind capacity on the sourcing side, along with around 3.5 GWh of battery energy storage system capacity.
The company said it is also expanding long-term supply contracts with bulk consumers, including industries, data centres, commercial entities and distribution companies.
Shares of Adani Energy Solutions closed at ₹1,491.80 on Friday, up 1.25% for the day.

title: Adani Energy Solutions gets order for 1,750 MW renewable power supply to West Bengal
